description: Events and event categories excluded from the dataset, with reasons. Scope rule: events must take place inside San Francisco city limits.

exclusions.name: Grand National Rodeo, Horse and Stock Show
exclusions.venue: Cow Palace, 2600 Geneva Ave, Daly City
exclusions.reason: Venue is in Daly City (unincorporated San Mateo County), outside San Francisco city limits. Listed in SF Travel's October guide under San Francisco events - flagged as a scope irregularity.
exclusions.source_name: SF Travel October guide (listing that was excluded)

exclusions.name: The Great Dickens Christmas Fair
exclusions.venue: Cow Palace, 2600 Geneva Ave, Daly City
exclusions.reason: Venue is in Daly City, outside San Francisco city limits (SF Travel's own December guide lists the Daly City address). Weekends from Nov 21, 2026.
exclusions.source_name: SF Travel December guide (listing that was excluded)

exclusions.name: Sonoma International Film Festival
exclusions.reason: Takes place in the town of Sonoma, outside San Francisco city limits. Appeared in SF Travel's March San Francisco events guide - flagged as a scope irregularity.
exclusions.source_name: SF Travel March guide (listing that was excluded)

exclusions.name: Mill Valley Film Festival
exclusions.venue: Mill Valley and other Marin County venues
exclusions.reason: Takes place in Marin County, outside San Francisco city limits. Appeared in SF Travel's October San Francisco events guide - flagged as a scope irregularity.
exclusions.source_name: SF Travel October guide (listing that was excluded)

exclusions.name: Beach Break Film Festival
exclusions.reason: Takes place in Half Moon Bay, outside San Francisco city limits. Appeared in SF Travel's December San Francisco events guide.
exclusions.source_name: SF Travel December guide (listing that was excluded)

exclusions.name: Holidays at Filoli
exclusions.venue: Filoli Historic House and Gardens, 86 Canada Rd, Woodside, CA
exclusions.reason: Takes place in Woodside, outside San Francisco city limits. Appeared in SF Travel's December San Francisco events guide, which itself notes the Woodside address.
exclusions.source_name: SF Travel December guide (listing that was excluded)

exclusions.name: Bay FC home games (NWSL soccer)
exclusions.reason: Although described as San Francisco's NWSL club in SF Travel's August guide, Bay FC plays home matches at PayPal Park in San Jose - outside San Francisco city limits.
exclusions.dates: 2026 season incl. home games Aug 1 and Aug 23, 2026 (per SF Travel)
exclusions.source_name: SF Travel August guide (listing that was excluded)

exclusions.name: FIFA World Cup 26 matches (Bay Area host city)
exclusions.reason: The Bay Area's FIFA World Cup matches are played at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara - outside San Francisco city limits - even though SF Travel's June guide says 'San Francisco will host six FIFA World Cup matches.' Only in-city watch parties and fan events are in scope.

exclusions.name: Super Bowl LX (the game)
exclusions.reason: The game itself is at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara. San Francisco fan events and activations are in scope (see Special Events).

exclusions.name: 626 Night Market (Bay Area)
exclusions.venue: Unverified for 2026 - historically Alameda County Fairgrounds, Pleasanton, CA
exclusions.reason: Aggregators list a Bay Area 626 Night Market (Oct 9-11, 2026) under San Francisco event guides, but the venue could not be confirmed to be inside San Francisco city limits from an official source. Excluded pending official confirmation.
exclusions.source_name: Aggregator listing (not an official source; venue unverified)

exclusions.name: Professional team home-game schedules (SF Giants at Oracle Park; Golden State Warriors at Chase Center)
exclusions.reason: In scope by location, but excluded from the events dataset by editorial decision: recurring professional sports league schedules (81 home games/season etc.) are a fixture category rather than individually listed events. Individual special events at these venues (e.g., Ballpark Back 9, concerts, FanFest) ARE included.
exclusions.source_name: SF Giants events page (scope decision context)

exclusions.name: Trade shows and professional conventions (e.g., Dreamforce, Microsoft Ignite, SEMICON West, AGU Fall Meeting at Moscone Center)
exclusions.reason: In scope by location, but excluded by editorial decision: professional conventions and trade shows are industry attendance events rather than public events. Large public consumer events at Moscone (e.g., Pokemon World Championships) ARE included.
exclusions.source_name: Moscone Center (official venue site; scope decision context)

exclusions.name: Opera at the Ballpark (claimed Nov 11, 2026 edition)
exclusions.reason: Irregularity: a third-party blog claimed a Nov 11, 2026 Opera at the Ballpark simulcast of La Traviata. The official San Francisco Opera 2026-27 season contains no La Traviata production, and the official simulcast page (sfopera.com/simulcast) appears to carry content from the November 11, 2022 La Traviata edition. No 2026 Opera at the Ballpark edition could be confirmed from official sources - excluded.
exclusions.source_name: SF Opera official 2026-27 season (used to disprove the claim)

exclusions.name: The Giant Race 2026 (date)
exclusions.reason: Event retained nowhere in the main tables pending date verification: SF Travel's September guide lists The Giant Race without a 2026 date; the Giants' events page shows 'August 17-18' (matching the 2024 edition); the race's own site was not updated with a 2026 date. The race's 2026 date is UNVERIFIED - see Flagged for Review. (Historically: 15th annual ran Aug 17-18, 2024, per race-sfgiants.com.)
exclusions.source_name: SF Giants Giant Race page (ambiguous year)
